name: Banner That Calls the Grain Rain (Đảo Vũ Phan)
effects: The Good Rain Knows Its Season
lore: A long banner of undyed hemp painted with the twenty-four seasons, raised over the terraces for the Grain Rain rite each year. The founder brought it from the coast in 610 (V154). Dương Hảo Vũ repainted its sea in green in 1000, when the abbey's rain began to come from the forest.
build_use: The abbess's rite piece: slow-starting, very long sustain for a whole group.

name: Gourd of Seed Rice (Chủng Mễ Hồ Lô)
lore: Holds the abbey's seed of spirit rice, kept from the first terrace of 612 and replanted every year from its own grain. The abbess carries it on her belt in the planting season and sleeps with it in a drought.
build_use: Health and healing; the abbey's patience in a gourd.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Seal of the Twenty-Four Seasons (Tiết Khí Ấn)
lore: The prior's seal of office, cut with the twenty-four solar terms around its face. It stamps the abbey's tax rolls to the Tower and its rice tallies, and the receipts in the prior's second book, for a rain that the rolls do not show.
build_use: Faster Wood arts and linh lực for the prior.

name: Robe of the Rain Abbess (Đảo Vũ Bào)
lore: A hemp rite robe dyed green with the forest's own leaves, which she put on in 1000 when she stopped calling rain from the sea. It is damp to the touch in any weather.
build_use: A soft rain that heals: healing, regeneration and linh lực.
